Every row of this page is a line of `internal/features` in spin, and a test there resolves it against the tree. A row that says **built** names what shows the feature exists - a procedure the control plane serves, a command the CLI has, or a test - and, under **End to end**, the tests that drive a real runner and its guest and check what the feature did, or what no test checks yet. spin's build checks that each of those tests is there and not quarantined; whether it checks the whole feature is its review's. A row that says **not built** is an item of [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/docs/ROADMAP.md). The page is written by `task reference` from `spin features` at spin `40ba7e572`, and cannot say a feature the binary does not. spin is a private repository: a link to its code opens only for someone with access to it.

|---|---|---|
| Egress is closed by default; policies, by tag, name what a workspace may reach | [An owner may only choose a policy the installation declares](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L192 "internal/e2e.TestAnOwnerMayOnlyChooseAPolicyTheInstallationDeclares") | [A workspace named no policy reaches nothing](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L63 "internal/e2e.TestAWorkspaceNamedNoPolicyReachesNothing")<br/>[Changing a workspaces policies reaches the host that runs it](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L19 "internal/e2e.TestChangingAWorkspacesPoliciesReachesTheHostThatRunsIt") |
| A workspace's DNS goes upstream only for what its policy names, so a policy that closes egress closes the tunnel through names | [A workspace asks its resolver only what its policy names](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/resolver_test.go#L64 "internal/e2e.TestAWorkspaceAsksItsResolverOnlyWhatItsPolicyNames") | [A workspace asks its resolver only what its policy names](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/resolver_test.go#L64 "internal/e2e.TestAWorkspaceAsksItsResolverOnlyWhatItsPolicyNames") |
| A policy changed reaches the host that runs the workspace | [Changing a workspaces policies reaches the host that runs it](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L19 "internal/e2e.TestChangingAWorkspacesPoliciesReachesTheHostThatRunsIt") | [An edited policy changes what a running guest reaches](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L89 "internal/e2e.TestAnEditedPolicyChangesWhatARunningGuestReaches")<br/>[Changing a workspaces policies reaches the host that runs it](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/retag_test.go#L19 "internal/e2e.TestChangingAWorkspacesPoliciesReachesTheHostThatRunsIt") |
| Brokered names: the runner's egress proxy stands in and adds what the workspace never holds - a team secret, a forge token, its identity, a cloud role<br/>*The team secret's value is read at the origin; the forge token, identity and cloud role injections have no test against the stack.* | [`spin team secret set`](/reference/cli/team/) | [A persons rule and an agents on one name each arrive with their own injection](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L75 "internal/e2e.TestAPersonsRuleAndAnAgentsOnOneNameEachArriveWithTheirOwnInjection") |
| What a workspace reached, what it looked up and what it was refused | [`spin workspace egress`](/reference/cli/workspace/) | [Egress is answered by the host the workspace runs on](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/cmd/cli/e2e_test.go#L881 "cmd/cli.TestE2E_EgressIsAnsweredByTheHostTheWorkspaceRunsOn") |
| Each request to a brokered name as the proxy read it, served or refused and why; and whether each injection's secret is the team's to give | [A brokered request is seen as the proxy read it](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L21 "internal/e2e.TestABrokeredRequestIsSeenAsTheProxyReadIt") | [A brokered request is seen as the proxy read it](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L21 "internal/e2e.TestABrokeredRequestIsSeenAsTheProxyReadIt") |
| The egress proxy is a process of its own, holding no key of the host's, started again by the runner when it ends | [The egress proxy is a process of its own that the runner starts again](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/egress_process_test.go#L15 "internal/e2e.TestTheEgressProxyIsAProcessOfItsOwnThatTheRunnerStartsAgain") | [The egress proxy is a process of its own that the runner starts again](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/egress_process_test.go#L15 "internal/e2e.TestTheEgressProxyIsAProcessOfItsOwnThatTheRunnerStartsAgain") |
| A brokered rule names whose it is, the agent's or the person's: one policy says what each may reach and with what | [A brokered name for the agent is the agents alone](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L54 "internal/e2e.TestABrokeredNameForTheAgentIsTheAgentsAlone") | [A persons rule and an agents on one name each arrive with their own injection](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L75 "internal/e2e.TestAPersonsRuleAndAnAgentsOnOneNameEachArriveWithTheirOwnInjection")<br/>[A brokered name for the agent is the agents alone](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L54 "internal/e2e.TestABrokeredNameForTheAgentIsTheAgentsAlone") |
| A WebSocket to a brokered name: its handshake under the rule's headers and scope, then bytes each way<br/>*The rule's header on the handshake is not read at the origin: the lane's WebSocket echo answers frames, not headers.* | [A WebSocket to a brokered name is carried after its handshake](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L137 "internal/e2e.TestAWebSocketToABrokeredNameIsCarriedAfterItsHandshake") | [A WebSocket to a brokered name carries the guests bytes and refuses a path out of scope](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L157 "internal/e2e.TestAWebSocketToABrokeredNameCarriesTheGuestsBytesAndRefusesAPathOutOfScope")<br/>[A WebSocket to a brokered name is carried after its handshake](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L137 "internal/e2e.TestAWebSocketToABrokeredNameIsCarriedAfterItsHandshake") |
| HTTP/2 to a brokered name, the proxy's ALPN the real host's: a rule's headers set stream by stream, gRPC's trailers both ways<br/>*gRPC's trailers are egressproxy's h2 test against an origin of its own; the lane has no gRPC origin to reach.* | [HTTP/2 to a brokered name is the real hosts](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L187 "internal/e2e.TestHTTP2ToABrokeredNameIsTheRealHosts") | [HTTP/2 to a brokered name is the real hosts](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L187 "internal/e2e.TestHTTP2ToABrokeredNameIsTheRealHosts")<br/>[Each stream of an HTTP/2 connection to a brokered name carries the rules header](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L203 "internal/e2e.TestEachStreamOfAnHTTP2ConnectionToABrokeredNameCarriesTheRulesHeader") |

| An agent the supervisor starts is marked, and reaches only brokered names | [A real workspace marks the agent its supervisor starts](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/seal_test.go#L17 "internal/e2e.TestARealWorkspaceMarksTheAgentItsSupervisorStarts") | [An agent reaches only brokered names](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/brokered_test.go#L110 "internal/e2e.TestAnAgentReachesOnlyBrokeredNames")<br/>[A real workspace marks the agent its supervisor starts](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/internal/e2e/seal_test.go#L17 "internal/e2e.TestARealWorkspaceMarksTheAgentItsSupervisorStarts") |
| Published ports at https://{port}-{workspace}.{domain}: private, whitelisted or public | [`spin port expose`](/reference/cli/port/) | [A public port is reached with no session at all](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/cmd/proxy/lane_test.go#L132 "cmd/proxy.TestAPublicPortIsReachedWithNoSessionAtAll")<br/>[a visitor signed in to the dashboard reaches their private port](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin/blob/40ba7e572a0041719cba3d5c5eae8ae1563a3817/dashboard/e2e/workspace-sign-in.spec.ts#L29 "workspace-sign-in.spec.ts") |

## Partly there

Nothing today.

## Not built

Each is an item of `docs/ROADMAP.md`, with the command that checks it.

- **What a workspace grew to is asked for and never recorded** (Workspaces)
- **Placement cannot be told which kind of host a workspace belongs on** (Workspaces)

## Limits

Not planned: a limit of the platform or of where it runs today. [Limitations](/overview/limitations/) says what each means.

- **AWS only** (Platform): The Terraform module is the one supported install; nothing else is packaged or tested.
- **x86-64 only** (Platform): Runners are x86-64 machines with nested virtualization.
- **The CLI runs on Linux and macOS** (Platform): x86-64 and Arm of each; there is no Windows build.
- **One region, one control plane** (Platform): A machine that fails is replaced in minutes, not seconds.
- **No GPUs** (Workspaces): A size names the class of runner its workspaces run on, and no class hands a workspace a GPU.
- **Linux guests only** (Workspaces): Booted with the kernel spin provides.
- **No IPv6 inside a workspace** (Network)
- **TCP only for published ports** (Network)
- **A diff does not see everything** (Snapshots): A file is hashed only when its size, inode or times changed; extended attributes are not compared.
- **A memory snapshot resumes only on the same machine** (Snapshots): The same QEMU, guest kernel and guest init; a disk restore has no such limit.
- **Disk chains have a limit** (Snapshots): At the limit the top layer grows instead, so less of the recent work is in the bucket.
- **Work since the last upload can be lost** (Snapshots): A runner uploads writes in layers, on the RPO, on snapshot and on stop; what it had not uploaded goes with it.
- **No multi-factor authentication of Spinbox's own** (Access): Sign in through a provider that enforces it.
- **No team invitations** (Access): A person signs in once before they can be added to a team; a workspace's guests are invited by email.
- **Team roles are fixed** (Access): Owner, admin and member.
- **Nothing pages the operator** (Observability): Metrics, logs and traces stay inside the installation; an alert rule fires in its Grafana, whose one contact point is the control plane, and the control plane emails the administrators when the installation has an email server set. An alert is an email, nothing louder. A workspace's owner is emailed when it waits for them.
- **An update is one way** (Administration): A release older than the one that last started the database refuses to start on it.
